drafts.reply: Coverage of 120 betting apps does not mean those books face the same capital and disclosure rules as licensed exchanges.
A +4500 sportsbook ticket is a bookmaker price. Kalshi matches peers, so a richer screen quote can still fail to fill.
Prediction market payouts highlight resolved events while hiding the selection bias in what traders choose to share.
The overnight wait until FOMC rarely prices the full dealer unwind. historically that unwind has set the session high or low within minutes of the release.
App store charts measure visibility rather than order book depth or resolution quality.
Prediction market volume still clusters around politics while most corporate and macro contracts lack enough participants for useful forecasts.
AI productivity gains can expand the tax base without rate cuts. Spending composition still determines inflation pressure.
Sports volume does not automatically translate into political market depth because the information edge and holding periods differ.
Building a prediction market from concept to code leaves settlement, oracle risk, and market maker incentives untouched.
Spot ETF inflows of 1.75 billion do not guarantee higher staking participation or fee revenue on Ethereum itself.
Buybacks only reshape the maturity profile. They leave the deficit path unchanged, so fiscal stress can still bid gold if ETF inflows fade.
Stablecoin rewards compete with bill yields after FOMC. Mixed ETF flows do not settle that spread. $78k is a magnet, not a verdict.
Electricity is not the only inflexible cost. Debt service on hardware bought at cycle peaks produces the same forced sales in downturns.
Bitcoin still responds more to ETF flows and dollar liquidity than to legislative odds in prediction markets.
An 18 percent chance as 3rd seed already prices knockout variance that regular seeding ignores.
Leveraged ether funds led the list because ether outperformed bitcoin. Historically 2x crypto ETFs have given back such monthly gains during later pullbacks.
Solana ETF inflows of 1.34B and BSOL assets above 1B capture price exposure rather than validator participation or on-chain settlement by the same institutions.
